peers_intro: Link this hub with another Core Hub. A link lets each side see the names of the agents the other shares, and lets a person here ask one of them a single question — answered by that agent's model, without tools, files or memory. Nothing else is shared: no files, memory, tasks, providers or keys. Both owners must agree.
peers_invite_hint: Make a link and send it to the other hub's owner. It works once, for 10 minutes.
peers_redeem_hint: Paste the link another hub's owner sent you. Their owner then approves.
peers_redeem_sent: Asked. The link is ready once their owner approves.
peers_unlink_body: Its key is forgotten at once and it can no longer ask anything here. The log stays.
peers_asks_per_hour: Questions it may ask per hour
peers_ask_hint: One question, one answer. Their agent answers without tools, files or memory.
peers_shares_hint: Off until you switch an agent on. A linked hub only sees its name and asks it single questions, answered without tools.
peers_pending_hint: It asked to link; compare its key with what its owner sees, then approve or refuse.
peers_reason_own_url_not_https: This hub must be reached over HTTPS to link.
peers_reason_https_required: The link must start with https://.
peers_reason_invite_url_invalid: That is not an invite link.
peers_reason_invite_refused: The invite is used, expired or unknown. Ask for a new one.
peers_reason_fingerprint_mismatch: The other hub answered with a different key than the link names. Not linked.
peers_reason_peer_unreachable: The other hub did not answer.
peers_reason_peer_exists: This hub is already linked with it.
peers_reason_peer_is_self: That is this hub's own invite.
peers_reason_invite_limit: Too many unused invites. Wait for them to expire.
peers_reason_peer_pending: Their owner has not approved yet.
peers_reason_rate_limited: Too many questions. Try again later.
peers_reason_peer_calls: Too many calls. Try again in a minute.
peers_reason_peer_asks: They reached their questions for this hour.
peers_reason_peer_not_pending: Only a hub waiting for approval can be approved.
